L08-C1.title: An interrupt mid-import is not handled; in-process, the half-written import stays open on the connection and the next workflow read commits it
L08-C1.What goes wrong: Ctrl-C (or SIGTERM under `interrupt_signals`) during an import called from a REPL / notebook / long-lived script leaves a partial corpus uncommitted on the connection; the first workflow status or gate check on that `ReviewDatabase` (or any other committing call) makes it durable: a truncated corpus (N of M papers), one paper at `FT_ELIGIBLE` with a ref but no `eligible` event, the eight screening stages still pending, under a manifest that never closes. For the screening entry the result is a silently truncated citation set at INGESTED that abstract screening will select. The retry is refused (R-e), so the only loud signal arrives after the partial is durable, and nothing in the stored state says "partial" other than the open manifest. If the process exits instead, SQLite rolls back and the DB is clean — see C2 for what is left.
L08-C1.Existing row: extends C47 (two new sites of the closed defect, with a worse consequence because the write is one deferred transaction) and C37 (the reader-side commit is what makes it durable).
L08-C1.Proposed class / package: 1 / P5 — a truncated corpus or citation set can become the stored review with no stored marker; condition: the import is interrupted in a process that goes on using the same connection.
L08-C1.Tests: `test_t6a_a_generic_failure_at_entry_2_rolls_back_and_closes_failed` (both test files) injects `RuntimeError` only; `tests/test_run_interrupts.py` (C47's T1–T9) does not cover the imports.

L08-C2.title: Interrupted extraction-entry import (process exit) leaves placed texts and an open manifest; the retry is refused until files are removed by hand
L08-C2.What goes wrong: after Ctrl-C / SIGTERM / kill / power loss, `parsed_text/` holds orphan `<pid>_v1.md` files no `parsed_text_refs` row names and the `import` manifest stays open forever (022's end-once trigger permits a later close, but nothing does it). The retry refuses loudly; the refusal text does not say the files are a previous attempt's or that they are safe to delete.
L08-C2.Proposed class / package: 2 / P5 — fails loudly, corrupts nothing; needs a manual clean-up no message names.

L08-C3.title: The bypass record ("Logged to audit trail") is one mutable row; `complete_stage` and `reset_stage` erase it
L08-C3.What goes wrong: a human gate is force-bypassed, downstream stages run (parse, extraction), then any later automatic completion of that stage rewrites the row to `complete`. The database no longer records that work proceeded past a bypassed gate; the same holds for the timestamp and note of an earlier legitimate completion (each re-run of screening or `run_pipeline` rewrites `completed_at`). `workflow_state` has no history table and writes no `paper_events` / manifest.
L08-C3.Existing row: new (A6's family: relational state updated in place outside the event store).
L08-C3.Proposed class / package: 1 / P2 — the stored record of a human gate goes silent about a bypass; lower to 3 if the log line is ruled to be the audit trail.
L08-C3.Tests: `test_bypass_stage`, `test_advance_stage_force`, `test_format_workflow_status_bypassed` assert the row immediately after the bypass; none completes the stage afterwards. `test_reset_stage` pins the erase.

L08-C4.title: `advance_stage` without `--force` records an "auto" human-gate stage as `complete` with no check of the condition the stage stands for; the sequence is enforced nowhere else
L08-C4.What goes wrong: (a) with stages 1–4 done, `advance_stage --stage ABSTRACT_ADJUDICATION_COMPLETE --note …` (no `--force`) stores `complete` — not `bypassed` — with flagged papers still unresolved, and `run_pipeline`'s adjudication gate opens; only the free-text note distinguishes it from the importer's completion. (b) Automatic completers call `complete_stage` out of order, so stage 5 can be `complete` and the gate open while stage 2 (the manual 50-paper diagnostic) is `pending`; stages 6–8 never gate extraction at all.
L08-C4.Proposed class / package: 1 / P4 for (a) — a human gate recorded as satisfied, not bypassed, by a path that checks nothing (operator-initiated, so the lead may read it as 3); 3 / P7 for (b), the "sequential enforcement" wording.
